about: The GraphQL mutations the door lets a fenced command make, each by its exact field name, with the skill that teaches the call and the call itself. No wildcards and no kin: a name not here is refused. A name is added only with the skill that uses it.

mutations.name: updateProjectV2ItemPosition
mutations.call: gh api graphql, Reordering Project Items, and scripts/reorder-project-item.sh

mutations.name: reprioritizeSubIssue
mutations.call: gh api graphql, Reordering Sub-Issues, and scripts/reorder-sub-issues.sh

mutations.name: addSubIssue
mutations.call: gh api graphql, creating a sub-issue under its parent, as the skill's description says it does

mutations.name: removeSubIssue
mutations.call: gh api graphql, taking a sub-issue from its parent

mutations.name: createIssue
mutations.call: gh issue create, as the skill and github-issue-format teach it

mutations.name: updateIssue
mutations.call: gh issue edit, its title and body

mutations.name: addLabelsToLabelable
mutations.call: gh issue edit and gh pr edit with --add-label, Metadata in Separate Commands

mutations.name: removeLabelsFromLabelable
mutations.call: gh issue edit and gh pr edit with --remove-label

mutations.name: replaceActorsForAssignable
mutations.call: gh issue edit and gh pr edit with --add-assignee @me, as github-issue-format and github-pr-format ask after a create

mutations.name: updatePullRequest
mutations.call: gh pr edit, its title and body

mutations.name: requestReviewsByLogin
mutations.call: gh pr edit with --add-reviewer, as gh 2.103 sends it
